node.title: Re^2: How to grep matching IP address from a log file?
node.author: dotowwxo
node.doctext:
Hello, thank you so much for your reply.

As you have mentioned, there will be 2 Ip addresses per line. One of it is my source IP, the other is the IP addresses I want to extract.

These are the fields of the actual line:

date time s-ip cs-method cs-uri-stem cs-uri-query s-port cs-username c-ip cs(User-Agent) sc-status sc-substatus sc-win32-status time-taken

Sample logs

2017-12-08 07:01:39 GET /course-detail.aspx id=66&catColor=0 443 - curl/7.19.7+(x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu)+libcurl/7.19.7+NSS/3.27.1+zlib/1.2.3+libidn/1.18+libssh2/1.4.2 200 0 0 530 2017-12-08 07:01:39 GET /course-listing.aspx - 443 - curl/7.19.7+(x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu)+libcurl/7.19.7+NSS/3.27.1+zlib/1.2.3+libidn/1.18+libssh2/1.4.2 200 0 0 140 2017-12-08 07:01:39 GET /course-detail.aspx id=24&catColor=0 443 - curl/7.19.7+(x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu)+libcurl/7.19.7+NSS/3.27.1+zlib/1.2.3+libidn/1.18+libssh2/1.4.2 200 0 0 93 2017-12-08 07:01:40 GET /logistics.aspx - 443 - curl/7.19.7+(x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu)+libcurl/7.19.7+NSS/3.27.1+zlib/1.2.3+libidn/1.18+libssh2/1.4.2 200 0 0 46 2017-12-08 07:01:40 GET /course-detail.aspx id=23&catColor=0 443 - curl/7.19.7+(x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu)+libcurl/7.19.7+NSS/3.27.1+zlib/1.2.3+libidn/1.18+libssh2/1.4.2 200 0 0 140

c-ip being the IP address I want to extract
